title: Write 16 · 关 左 右 旁 净 系 语 汉 睡 四 妈 谢 第 二 错
focus: 关 左 右 旁 净 系 语 汉 睡 四 妈 谢 第 二 错
body:
Directions and family: 左, 右, 旁边, 关系, 汉语, 谢谢, 第二.

## Repeating parts
- **讠 speech**: on the left of 语 and 谢.
- **女 woman**: on the left of 妈. Its last stroke turns into a rising ㇀.
- **冫 ice vs 氵 water:** 净 has 2 dots, 汉 has 3.
- **⺮ bamboo**: on top of 第.

## Rules that matter here
- **左 vs 右:** 左 starts with 一, then 丿. 右 starts with 丿, then 一. In 右 the 丿 is the long stroke, so it goes first.
- **Close the box last:** in 四, write the frame, then 儿, then the bottom 一.

cards.Notes: 丷 over 天. 6 strokes: 丶, 丿, 一, 一, 丿, ㇏. Lookalike 美 měi; and 送 = 关 + 辶.
𠂇 hand + 工. 5 strokes: 一 FIRST, then 丿, then 工 (一, 丨, 一). Compare 右, which starts with 丿.
𠂇 hand + 口. 5 strokes: 丿 FIRST, then 一, then 口. Compare 左, which starts with 一.
10 strokes, top to bottom: 亠 (丶, 一), 丷, 冖, then 方 fāng (phonetic) at the bottom (丶, 一, 𠃌, 丿).
冫 ice (2 strokes) + 争 zhēng (phonetic). 8 strokes. 冫, then 争 (⺈, then 彐-like part, then 亅 down the middle last). Not 氵.
丿 over 糸 silk thread. 7 strokes. 丿, then 糸 (𠃋, 𠃋, 丶, 亅, 丿, 丶).
讠 speech + 吾 wú (phonetic). 9 strokes. 讠, then 吾: 五 (一, 丨, ㇕, 一) over 口.
氵 water + 又 (a simplified shape; originally the Han river). 5 strokes. 氵 (丶, 丶, ㇀), then 又 (㇇, ㇏).
目 eye + 垂 chuí droop (phonetic): drooping eyelids. 13 strokes. 目 (5) first, then 垂 (8): 丿, then the 一 and 丨 strokes, ending with the long bottom 一.
囗 frame with 儿 inside. 5 strokes: 丨, 𠃍, then 丿, 乚 inside, and the bottom 一 last. Close the box last.
女 woman + 马 mǎ (phonetic). 6 strokes. 女 (㇛, 丿, ㇀), then 马 (𠃍, ㇉, ㇀).
讠 speech + 射 shè (phonetic). 12 strokes, left to right: 讠, then 身 (7), then 寸 (一, 亅, 丶).
⺮ bamboo + 弟 dì (phonetic; its top 丷 is dropped). 11 strokes. ⺮ first. 弟's long 丨 is written before the final 丿.
Two lines. 2 strokes: a short 一 on top, a longer 一 below.
钅 metal + 昔 xī (phonetic). 13 strokes. 钅 (丿, 一, 一, 一, ㇙), then 昔 (一, 丨, 丨, 一, then 日).
